user.title: Connect to HA Frame
user.description: Enable the Home Assistant integration on the frame, then create a 2-minute pairing code in the frame's settings.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect, invalid/expired code, or frame integration disabled

init.title: Dashboard configuration
init.description: Changes are applied directly to the frame over the LAN. Finish when done.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Keep CSS to preserve existing custom styling. Choosing another preset replaces the entire custom stylesheet.

css.title: Custom Canvas CSS
css.description: Only the supported native Canvas CSS subset is accepted. Paste CSS here (12,000 characters maximum); leave blank to reset it.

page_details.title: Edit page
page_details.description: Maximum three rows; first remove cards if reducing columns.

page_remove.title: Delete page
page_remove.description: All cards on the selected page will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

tile_add.title: Add tile
tile_add.description: Choose an entity using the Home Assistant entity picker. Min/max apply to gauges.

tile_details.title: Edit tile
tile_details.description: To clear the existing entity, enable Leave unassigned.

tile_remove.title: Delete tile
tile_remove.description: The chosen tile will be removed from the dashboard.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the frame. Check Wi-Fi and the HA integration setting on the PF1007.
error.invalid_config: The frame rejected the layout or CSS. Check the fields and supported Canvas CSS.
error.invalid_move: This item cannot be moved in that direction.
error.last_page: At least one page must remain.
